imf-fm.title: Fiscal Monitor, October 2026 (via the IMF DataMapper)
imf-fm.notes: General government gross debt, revenue, overall balance and primary balance, % of GDP. Net interest is the primary balance minus the overall balance: interest paid less interest received. 2025 values are partly estimates; 2026 to 2031 are IMF projections.

imf-weo.title: World Economic Outlook, October 2026: general government gross debt (GGXWDG_NGDP)
imf-weo.notes: World aggregate, % of world GDP, 2001 to 2031. 2026 onward are projections.

wb-health.publisher: World Health Organization Global Health Expenditure Database, via the World Bank
wb-health.title: Domestic general government health expenditure (% of GDP), SH.XPD.GHED.GD.ZS
wb-health.notes: Government spending on health from its own resources, excluding foreign aid. Latest year, mostly 2023. CC BY 4.0.

wb-edu.publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics, via the World Bank
wb-edu.title: Government expenditure on education, total (% of GDP), SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS
wb-edu.notes: All levels of government, latest year since 2019, mostly 2022 to 2024. CC BY 4.0.

unctad-wod.title: A World of Debt 2026: Rising debt costs and stalling development
unctad-wod.notes: Developing countries only. Net interest on public debt, 2025; health and education spending, latest year.

wb-idr.title: International Debt Report 2025: press release
wb-idr.notes: External debt of low- and middle-income countries, end-2024.

ons-psf.title: Public sector finances, UK: September 2026 (series NMFX, JW2O and HF6X)
ons-psf.notes: Central government net interest payable (NMFX, £m), public sector current receipts (JW2O, £m) and public sector net debt excluding public sector banks (HF6X, % of GDP). Financial years run April to March. Open Government Licence v3.0.

natural-earth.title: Admin 0 countries, 1:110m
natural-earth.notes: Public domain. Used to match countries to map shapes.
